targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Events" FROM bi_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))

SELECT count(DISTINCT camera) AS "Cameras" FROM bi_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))

SELECT max(event_time) AS "Last" FROM bi_events WHERE ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))

SELECT coalesce(sum(count),0) AS "IN" FROM bi_events WHERE direction='IN' AND count IS NOT NULL AND direction IN ('IN','OUT') AND (report_type IS NULL OR report_type ILIKE '%punctual%') AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))

SELECT coalesce(sum(count),0) AS "OUT" FROM bi_events WHERE direction='OUT' AND count IS NOT NULL AND direction IN ('IN','OUT') AND (report_type IS NULL OR report_type ILIKE '%punctual%') AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))

SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE direction WHEN 'IN' THEN count ELSE -count END),0) AS "Net"
FROM bi_events WHERE count IS NOT NULL AND direction IN ('IN','OUT') AND (report_type IS NULL OR report_type ILIKE '%punctual%') AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))

panels.title: Counts over time by object type & direction

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(event_time, $__interval), coalesce(object_type,'Object') || ' ' || direction AS metric, sum(count) AS value
FROM bi_events WHERE count IS NOT NULL AND direction IN ('IN','OUT') AND (report_type IS NULL OR report_type ILIKE '%punctual%') AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Totals by camera, counting rule & object type

targets.rawSql:
SELECT camera, analytic AS type, rule_name AS rule, coalesce(object_type,'Object') AS object_type,
  sum(count) FILTER (WHERE direction='IN')  AS "IN",
  sum(count) FILTER (WHERE direction='OUT') AS "OUT",
  sum(count) AS total
FROM bi_events WHERE count IS NOT NULL AND direction IN ('IN','OUT') AND (report_type IS NULL OR report_type ILIKE '%punctual%') AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (camera, rule_name) camera || ' · ' || coalesce(rule_name,'queue') AS queue, count AS "people"
FROM bi_events WHERE analytic ILIKE '%queue%' AND count IS NOT NULL AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))
ORDER BY camera, rule_name, event_time DESC

SELECT event_time AS time, camera || ' · ' || coalesce(rule_name,'queue') AS metric, count AS value
FROM bi_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND analytic ILIKE '%queue%' AND count IS NOT NULL AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))
ORDER BY 1

SELECT camera || ' · ' || coalesce(rule_name,'queue') AS queue,
  (array_agg(count ORDER BY event_time DESC))[1] AS "current",
  max(count) AS "peak",
  count(*) AS "changes",
  max(event_time) AS "last change"
FROM bi_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND analytic ILIKE '%queue%' AND count IS NOT NULL AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "peak" DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (camera, rule_name) camera || ' · ' || coalesce(rule_name,'area') AS area, count AS "people"
FROM bi_events WHERE analytic ILIKE '%crowd%' AND count IS NOT NULL AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))
ORDER BY camera, rule_name, event_time DESC

SELECT event_time AS time, camera || ' · ' || coalesce(rule_name,'area') AS metric, count AS value
FROM bi_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND analytic ILIKE '%crowd%' AND count IS NOT NULL AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))
ORDER BY 1

SELECT camera || ' · ' || coalesce(rule_name,'area') AS area,
  (array_agg(count ORDER BY event_time DESC))[1] AS "current",
  max(count) AS "peak",
  (array_agg(event_time ORDER BY count DESC, event_time DESC))[1] AS "peak time",
  count(*) AS "changes",
  max(event_time) AS "last change"
FROM bi_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND analytic ILIKE '%crowd%' AND count IS NOT NULL AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "peak" DESC

SELECT event_time AS time, camera, analytic AS type, rule_name AS rule, object_type, direction, count, data::text AS data
FROM bi_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('__all' IN ($camera) OR camera IN ($camera)) AND ('__all' IN ($analytic) OR analytic IN ($analytic)) AND ('__all' IN ($rule) OR rule_name IN ($rule))
ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200
